newsitem.title: USA: Edisto sells gas unit to Pacific Gas.
newsitem.headline: Edisto sells gas unit to Pacific Gas.

text.p: Edisto Resources Corp said Monday that it has agreed to sell its gas marketing operations to a unit of Pacific Gas and Electric Co for $28 million in cash and about $20.6 million in working capital.
The sale to Pacific Gas Tranmission Co is expected to close before December 31, Edisto said.
It would give Pacific Gas substantially all the assets of Edisto's gas marketing subsidiaries, known jointly as Energy Source.
Energy Source management and employees, including Energy Source President David Tudor, should remain with the company after the acquisition, Edisto said.
Pacific Gas Transmission said it "will continue to seek additional midstream gas investment opportunities" after this acquisition.
Energy Source has average daily natural gas sales of more than two billion cubic feet, Edisto said.
Edisto said, after the sale, it will continue oil and gas operations through its 73 percent interest in Convest Energy Corp.
Edisto's unofficial closing price on Monday was 10, down 1/8 from Friday's close. Pacific Gas Electric's was also down 1/8 Monday at 23-3/4.
